description: Reconstructs the published Toffoli diagonal P_77 = (q + q^{1/2} - 1)/(q+1) from the transfer-matrix block's own recipe V_1 = z*c + d, and finds it is exactly z_C + (q-1)/(q+1) -- convention C, excised 2026-08-09. Its golden-ratio zero at q = 1/phi^2 is therefore a C-frame feature: the same recipe at the canonical z_D has its root at 0.6631 instead, 74% away. At q0 the two differ by 21% and both stay positive, so the q-GoL stability VERDICT survives the convention while the threshold and the number do not. scope-(a).
caveats: The z_D column is NOT the convention-D Toffoli diagonal. Substituting z_D into a closed form derived under C is not a migration -- AGENTS.md states this for the c_k ladder and it applies verbatim here. The column establishes only that the golden-ratio root is not invariant under the convention. What the D-frame diagonal is remains open and is content work.
